title: Three hosts, an unfed guest
literal_meaning: A guest of three households goes unfed.
meaning_odia: ତିନି ଘରର କୁଣିଆ ହୋଇ ମଧ୍ୟ ଖାଇବାକୁ ନପାଇବାର ଚିତ୍ର ଏହା। ଆମ ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟାରେ, ଅନେକଙ୍କ ଉପରେ ଭରସା ରହିଲେ ମଧ୍ୟ କିଏ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ଭାବରେ କାମଟି କରିବ ତାହା ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ନହେଲେ ଦରକାରୀ କାମ ଅକରା ରହିଯାଇପାରେ। ଜଣେ ଅନ୍ୟଜଣଙ୍କ ଉପରେ ଛାଡ଼ିଦେବା ଏହାକୁ ବୁଝାଇବାର ଏକ ଉଦାହରଣ; କାରଣଟି ମୂଳ ଧାଡ଼ିରେ କୁହାଯାଇନାହିଁ।
explanation: Three households appear to offer more support than one, yet the guest still has no meal. Our editorial reading is that shared responsibility can fail when nobody clearly takes it on. The familiar scenario in which each host assumes another has provided food illustrates the saying; it is not narrated in the source.
usage_example: Original imagined example: Three colleagues each assume someone else has arranged lunch for a visitor. When the visitor is left waiting, one of them recalls the guest of three households.
cultural_context: The contrast is numerical and practical: three households, but no meal. ଓପାସ is read here as remaining unfed, rather than undertaking a religious fast.

witnesses.locator: Page21, final two identical lines beginning ତିନି ଘର କୁଣିଆ.
witnesses.note: Rendered upload inspected17November2026; repeated wording treated as one saying. Exact କୁଣିଆ and ଓପାସ retained. Explanation of divided responsibility is editorial, not an explicit causal statement in the source.

odia_summary: ଦାୟିତ୍ୱ କାହାର ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ନହେଲେ ଅନେକଙ୍କ ଭରସାରେ ମଧ୍ୟ କାମ ଅକରା ରହିପାରେ।
english_summary: Several potential helpers can still leave a need unmet.
